information.description:
The tougher, more experienced cops, and the badges you'll see most in Night City.

NCPD: Night City's police, from beat cops to SWAT.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
information.notes:
Threat: Hardened Mook • Reputation: 2 • Facedown #: 6 • COM#: 12 • Role: Solo: Combat Awareness 1 Enforcer: Officer 1 (Authority 1)

Enforcer: When interacting with other NCPD members that they have some level of seniority over, Patrol Officers gain a +1 bonus to Acting, Bribery, Conversation, Interrogation, and Persuasion Skill Checks against them.

Carries one of the listed weapons (GM's choice); both are on the sheet.

With gear or role bonuses: Persuasion 8 (9)

Melee SP (head/body): 4/6
